British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REG. No 5 B. D. 9868 Date 21 / 3）

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I wish to thank you for the information
contained in the memorandum of the 14th instant
regarding Dr. F. J. Ferod, which was very helpful.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处转录不清〕
Passport Control Officer.

R. W. Yorke, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

page_data.en:
British Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI
28th February 1940.
S. B. Reg.
No. S. B. D. — 9868
Date ____ / ____ / 40

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I enclose a copy of a letter received from
Mrs. Herod enquiring as to the whereabouts of her
husband Mr. Ernest John Herod (known as Hiram).

There is no trace of Mr. Herod ever having
registered at this Consulate-General (1915-1940) and
there is also no trace of any passport facilities
having been granted to him (1916-1939).

Can you possibly help us please?.

Yours sincerely,
〔签名〕
Passport Control Officer.

R. W. Yorke, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D. S. McKeown
E's
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海
1940年2月28日。
S. B. 登记
编号 S. B. D. — 9868
日期 ____ / ____ / 40

亲爱的约克先生：

现附上收到的一封来自 Herod 夫人的信件副本，信中询问其丈夫 Ernest John Herod 先生（又名 Hiram）的下落。

在本总领事馆的记录中（1915-1940年），查无 Herod 先生曾在此登记的痕迹，亦无任何向其签发护照便利的记录（1916-1939年）。

能否请您协助我们？

此致
敬礼
〔签名〕
护照管制官。

R. W. Yorke 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D. S. McKeown
E's

page_data.en:
(COPY)
"Iverna",
Brighton Road,
Lancing,
England.
5/2/40.

The British Consul-General,
Shanghai,
China.

Dear Sir,
I have been advised by the British Consul of
Sourabaya, Java to write to you regarding my husband Mr.
Ernest John Herod, known as Hiram J. Herod. He was, on my
leaving Singapore for home leave, employed by H. M. Naval
Base S'pore. Things went wrong, exactly what, I do not
know, but he did not write to me after a few months and I
have had to trace him through solicitors. I located him in
Java. He left there for, I believe, Shanghai on August 18th
or 19th 1939. He has not kept his promise to notify the B.C. of
Sourabaya of this address so we are all without the slightest
trace of him and I was, as stated before, advised to write
to you to see if he has made contact with your office, or
maybe you could find him. His description is as follows:-
6 ft. ½ inch tall
Fair hair
Eyes blue
Scar over right eyebrow.
Well built
Weight 168-169 lbs
Legs badly scarred from war wounds and leech bites, also
varicose veins (not bad)

He told me in the last letter sent from Java he was
joining the Chinese Army. I do hope and pray you can give me
news of him. We have not quarrelled or had any ill feeling.
He was, he said in his letters just longing for me to return.
I/
page_data.zh:
（副本）
“Iverna”，
Brighton Road，
Lancing，
英格兰。
1940年2月5日。

致：
中国上海
英国总领事

尊敬的先生：

爪哇泗水英国领事建议我就我丈夫 Ernest John Herod 先生（又名 Hiram J. Herod）一事致函阁下。在我离开新加坡回国休假时，他受雇于新加坡英国海军基地。后来出了岔子，具体情形我并不知晓，但数月后他便不再写信给我，我不得不通过律师寻找他的下落。我在爪哇找到了他。据信，他于1939年8月18日或19日从那里前往上海。他并未履行向泗水英国领事馆通报此地址的承诺，因此我们对他毫无头绪。如前所述，有人建议我写信给您，看他是否与贵处取得联系，或者或许您能找到他。他的体貌特征如下：
身高 6 英尺半英寸
金发
蓝眼睛
右眉上方有疤痕。
体格健壮
体重 168-169 磅
腿部因战伤和水蛭叮咬留有严重疤痕，另有静脉曲张（不严重）

他在从爪哇发出的最后一封信中告诉我，他即将加入中国军队。我衷心希望并祈祷您能告知我有关他的消息。我们并未争吵，也没有任何不和。他在信中说，他只是渴望我回去。我/

page_data.en:
2.

I had then only been home three months, so you can guess
how I feel with his silence.
        Please forgive any trouble I am giving you, but
I do so want to try and find him and if possible to start
him on a happier existence than he has been living lately.
                I am,
                    Yours faithfully,

            (SIGNED)    DOROTHY D. HEROD.

------------------
page_data.zh:
2.

当时我回家才三个月，所以您可以想象他的沉默让我作何感想。
        请原谅给您带来的麻烦，但我非常希望能找到他，如果可能的话，让他开始一种比最近更幸福的生活。
                此致
                    敬礼

            （签名）    DOROTHY D. HEROD。
